title: thalictrum minus f. macrophyllum
intro: Thalictrum minus f. macrophyllum, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a flowering plant in the buttercup family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents of Meadow Rue include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
